data.case_title: Muster BKK rejects cost coverage for orthopedic insoles
data.explanation: Your health insurer (Krankenkasse) reviewed your application for sensorimotor orthopedic insoles and decided not to cover them, because this type of insole is not listed in the official aids catalogue (Hilfsmittelverzeichnis) and its therapeutic benefit is not proven. They will cover ordinary insoles instead, minus the statutory co-payment. If you disagree, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK; the app shows until when you can still do this. If you take no action, this decision becomes final. Since your case involves a medical prescription, you may want to ask your doctor or a patient advice service (Patientenberatung) whether the sensorimotor insoles are medically necessary before deciding.
data.title: Rejection of cost coverage for orthopedic insoles

items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: Decide whether to file a written or electronic objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK if you disagree with the rejection.
items.consequence: If you do not object by the deadline shown, the rejection of cost coverage for the sensorimotor insoles becomes final.

key_facts.value: zwei Paar herkömmliche Einlagen abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung
key_facts.quote: Die Kosten für zwei Paar herkömmliche Einlagen übernehmen wir abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for rejection
key_facts.quote: Sensomotorische Einlagen sind nicht im Hilfsmittelverzeichnis gelistet; ihr therapeutischer Nutzen ist nicht nachgewiesen (§ 33 SGB V).

remedy.quote: Der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, in elektronischer Form oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK, Beispielweg 1, 34117 Neu-Musterdorf, einzulegen.

data.summary: Muster BKK (health insurer) informs David Muster that it will not cover the costs of the requested sensomotoric orthopedic insoles applied for on 2 April 2025, as they are not listed in the Hilfsmittelverzeichnis and lack proven therapeutic benefit; it will instead cover two pairs of standard insoles minus the statutory co-payment. He may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification if he disagrees.
